registryKey.description: Who provides basedpython log points — the inline Log: field and Add Log Point. auto is this plugin, in every IDE: the IDE's own log points (IntelliJ IDEA, and PyCharm since 263.7355) serve only breakpoint types that support inter-line placement, which basedpython-line cannot claim, and Add Log Point still gives Ctrl+Alt+F8 to the IDE's Add Logpoint wherever that is enabled. ide always gives way.

localInspection.displayName: print() call can be replaced with a log point
